SR-001.justification: Every slice 0..=24 octets with each TPID/other word at offsets 12 and 16 is viewed and asserted to have a view exactly when 14 + 4 x tags fits; 100 000 random slices up to 1600 octets read every accessor and assert the payload lies inside the slice. Both pass (cargo test, 2026-11-09).

SR-002.justification: For three TPID-free sets and every layout of 0-3 tags of either TPID with four inner types, asserts Program::ethertypes(S).run(frame) != 0 exactly when the view's EtherType is in S. Passes.

SR-003.justification: Asserts VlanTag::new refuses PCP 8 and VID 4096, and that VID 4095 + PCP 7 + DEI gives TCI 0xFFFF. Passes.

SR-004.justification: A Vec and a fixed 1518-octet slice prefilled with 0xAA receive a 5-octet-payload frame; asserts length 60, octets 19..60 zero, nothing written past the frame, and a 59-octet slice yields InvalidInput naming 60 with the slice untouched. Passes.

SR-005.justification: Asserts reply() is None for sources ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff and 01:00:5e:00:00:01, and that a unicast-sourced tagged frame gets a reply to its sender with the same tags and EtherType. Passes.

SR-006.justification: The rustdoc of Frame::payload and Packet::frame both name Packet::is_truncated and say a truncated packet's payload is the captured part only; the receiving guide says the same. Acceptance is a documentation read, satisfied by review.
